leagues.name: Liga Portugal Betclic (Primeira Liga)
notes: 18 clubs for 2026-27, from the Wikipedia season page (the official ligaportugal.pt site is a news hub and did not expose a club list). Season runs 7 Aug 2026 to 16 May 2027; promoted: Maritimo and Academico de Viseu; relegated: AVS and Tondela.
Title/naming sponsor Betclic since 2023-24 (previously Bwin 2021/22-2022/23); competition branded 'Liga Portugal Betclic'.

Most front-of-shirt sponsors are Portuguese betting brands (Placard, Betano, bwin, Solverde.pt, Lebull) plus Emirates at Benfica. Other placements are largely local sponsors (Hospital da Luz, Lusiadas, Super Bock, Sagres).

owners.name: Santa Casa da Misericordia de Lisboa (Jogos Santa Casa)
owners.note: Portuguese charitable institution that runs Portugal's social games 'on behalf and on account of the State' under an exclusive regime, overseen by the government minister responsible for social security. Its Jogos Santa Casa arm runs the Placard betting brand (SCML itself: 'O Placard, produto dos Jogos Santa Casa'; online licence held by SAS Apostas Sociais, Jogos e Apostas Online, S.A., per the SRIJ register). Sources opened: https://scml.pt/jogos-santa-casa/ (exclusivity statement), https://scml.pt/comunicacao/noticias/placard-da-nome-a-supertaca-candido-de-oliveira/ ('produto dos Jogos Santa Casa'), https://www.srij.turismodeportugal.pt/pt/jogos-e-apostas-online/entidades-licenciadas (licence 013 held by SAS Apostas Sociais).

owners.name: Grupo Solverde (Solverde - Sociedade de Investimentos Turisticos da Costa Verde)
owners.note: Portuguese casino and hotel group founded in Espinho in 1972; per its 2025 annual report (cited on Portuguese Wikipedia), 93.67% held by Violas SGPS (Manuel Violas family). Private Portuguese owners, no state link.

owners.name: Southern Stingray, S.A.
owners.note: SRIJ-licensed Portuguese operating entity of the Lebull online betting brand (licences 027/028). Ownership not disclosed in sources checked.

owners.name: Azartia Games, S.A.
owners.note: SRIJ-licensed Portuguese operating entity of the GoldenPark brand (licences 029/030). Trade press (iGaming Business, 5 Jul 2023) reported the Portuguese licences; ownership beyond the SRIJ register entry not found in sources checked.

owners.name: Qatar Sports Investments (QSI)
owners.note: Wholly owned by the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA); chaired by Nasser Al-Khelaifi; controlling owner of Paris Saint-Germain since 2011.

owners.name: Super Bock Group
owners.note: Portuguese brewer, privately held; 56% held by holding VIACER (itself 71.5% Violas group / 28.5% Carlsberg) and 44% directly by Carlsberg (per pt.wikipedia Super Bock Group corporate structure). Largest single owner group is the Portuguese Violas family; Carlsberg (Denmark) holds a large economic interest. No state link.

owners.name: Sociedade Central de Cervejas e Bebidas (SCC)
owners.note: Portuguese brewer of the Sagres brand; owned 100% by the Heineken Group since March 2008. Heineken is an Amsterdam-listed family-controlled brewer, no state link.

owners.name: Grupo SATA
owners.note: Azores airline group (Azores Airlines, SATA Air Acores). Became a public company in 1980 with 50% of shares held by the Regional Government of the Azores and the remainder by TAP Air Portugal (per pt.wikipedia SATA Air Acores / Grupo SATA); the government of the Azores remains the controlling public owner. Opened https://www.azoresairlines.pt/en/corporate and corporate-governance/investors pages - they link governance documents but do not print current percentages, so the 50% figure is from the Portuguese Wikipedia history section.

owners.name: Grupo Media Capital
owners.note: Portuguese media group (TVI free-to-air channel; TVI's controlling shareholder is Media Capital, ultimately controlled by Prisa, Spain). Recorded for the TVI front placement at Moreirense; ownership detail left in note only.

sponsors.name: Betclic
sponsors.note: Title/naming sponsor of Liga Portugal since 2023-24 ('Liga Portugal Betclic'); league-partner deal recorded separately. Operator per SRIJ register: BEM OPERATIONS LIMITED.

sponsors.name: Placard (Jogos Santa Casa)
sponsors.note: Portuguese state-linked fixed-odds sports betting product of Jogos Santa Casa; online licences held by SAS Apostas Sociais, Jogos e Apostas Online, S.A. (SRIJ). Main kit sponsor at Alverca, Moreirense and Vitoria SC in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Solverde.pt
sponsors.note: Online casino/betting brand of Grupo Solverde (casinos Espinho, Vilamoura, Monte Gordo, Portimao, Chaves); SRIJ-licensed. Main kit sponsor at SC Braga and Estoril Praia in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Lebull
sponsors.note: Portuguese online betting brand (SRIJ licence 027, operator Southern Stingray, S.A.). Main kit sponsor at Estrela da Amadora, Rio Ave and Santa Clara in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Goldenpark Casino
sponsors.note: Portuguese online casino/betting brand; SRIJ licence 029 held by Azartia Games, S.A. Main kit sponsor at Gil Vicente in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Super Bock
sponsors.note: Portuguese beer brand (Super Bock Group). Back-of-shirt sponsor at Porto and Sporting CP, and an official sponsor at Braga, in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Sagres
sponsors.note: Portuguese beer brand of Sociedade Central de Cervejas e Bebidas (100% Heineken since 2008). Back-of-shirt sponsor at Benfica in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
sponsors.note: Portuguese private hospital group (Luz Saude, 60% Fidelidade / 40% Macquarie since Sep 2025; Fidelidade is 85% Fosun / 15% state-owned CGD). Front or sleeve sponsor at several clubs in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Azores Airlines (SATA)
sponsors.note: Airline of the Azores-based SATA group, controlled by the Regional Government of the Azores. Front-of-shirt sponsor at Santa Clara in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Visabeira
sponsors.note: Portuguese conglomerate (telecoms, energy, industry incl. Vista Alegre, tourism, construction), founded in Viseu in 1980. Main kit sponsor at Academico de Viseu in 2026-27. Controlling owners not stated in the sources checked.

sponsors.name: TVI
sponsors.note: Portuguese free-to-air TV channel (Media Capital group). Front-of-shirt sponsor at Moreirense in 2026-27.

sponsors.name: Madeira. Tao tua
sponsors.note: 'Madeira. Tua' destination-marketing slogan of the Madeira island authorities; appears as front-of-shirt sponsor at Maritimo and back at Nacional in 2026-27. The branding body (Madeira Promotion Bureau / regional government) not yet verified from a primary source.

sponsors.name: Cerveja Coral
sponsors.note: Madeira beer brand of the Madeira Brewery (Empresa de Cerveja da Madeira), controlled since 1999 by the Pestana Group with the Miles family. Back-of-shirt sponsor at Nacional in 2026-27.

proposedRatings.reasoning: Benfica's front-of-shirt sponsor is Emirates, whose parent (The Emirates Group) is owned by the Investment Corporation of Dubai, Dubai's sovereign wealth fund - a Gulf state chain that the site already rates serious for the same sponsor elsewhere (existing sponsor record: Emirates, tier serious, owner government-of-dubai). Proposal only; a person decides.

Placard is the betting brand of Jogos Santa Casa, which operates Portugal's games on behalf of the Portuguese state under an exclusive regime, so the main shirt slot at three Liga Portugal clubs (Alverca, Moreirense, Vitoria Guimaraes) is state-linked money. Portugal has no serious state-level abuse record, so this is a lesser state link, hence concern at most. Proposal only; a person decides.

Betano is owned by Kaizen Gaming (private Greek/Czech investors, Allwyn holds 36.75%), with no state owner - the site already rates it none. Front-of-shirt sponsor at both Porto and Sporting CP. Proposal only; a person decides.

unsourced: The Wikipedia 2026-27 Personnel and kits table (which sourced most per-club placements above) carries no inline citations for the kit/sponsor rows; each club's kit-launch or club announcement page still needs to be opened before sponsorsComplete can be true. Only Benfica (Emirates front, Sportcal 2024-08-14; Betano sleeve renewal), Porto (Betano front, Kaizen Gaming 2026-07-30), Sporting CP (Betano front, Kaizen Gaming 2025-08-08) and Braga's sponsor tiers (club sponsors page) were verified against non-Wikipedia pages.

Kit makers for 2026-27 (Adidas, Nike, Puma, Joma, Hummel, Umbro, Kappa, New Balance, Reebok, and the small brands Skita, CDT, Hummel) are from the same Wikipedia table and were not individually confirmed.

QSI's current (2026) holding in SC Braga SAD: the 29.60% figure is dated 2023 (Wikipedia, citing club/share-register sources). CMVM filings or the SAD's share capital report should confirm whether the stake still stands; the QIA-ownership link of QSI is stated on Wikipedia but not in the Plataforma Media deal article.

Emirates' own press release (https://www.emirates.com/media-centre/emirates-raises-commitment-to-portugal-with-benfica-shirt-sponsorship/, 19 May 2015) was fetched and read via curl; it documents the original 2015 front-of-shirt deal, not the 2024 extension to 2029 (that is Sportcal).
Deal values for Liga Portugal clubs (front-of-shirt amounts) were not found in opened sources; no league frontOfShirtTotal set.

League partners beyond Betclic: ligaportugal.pt's commercial page names Betclic as title sponsor; the league homepage showed 'Meu Super' and 'Allianz' in a sponsor block and (per the fetched capture) official sponsors (Abanca, Puma, Continente, Haier, Zome), official partners (Domino's, Super Bock, Solinca, Under Blue, Skoiy, MG, TrueClinic, JCDecaux, Sabseg, SoftLight) and suppliers (WTVision, Camaleonic) - those homepage logo-strip readings were from one truncated capture and were not turned into deals.

Allianz also titles the league cup ('Allianz Cup', Taça da Liga, since 2018 per Wikipedia) - recorded here only as a note, not a deal, because it is a cup naming rather than the league competition this target covers.

Placard's operator SAS Apostas Sociais is per the SRIJ register; SCML's own site calls Placard 'produto dos Jogos Santa Casa' but the corporate link between SCML and SAS Apostas Sociais was not documented from a primary filing (SCML annual report not found online in sources opened).

Lebull's operator Southern Stingray, S.A. and Goldenpark's operator Azartia Games, S.A. are known only from the SRIJ register; their shareholders were not found in opened sources (the 2023 iGB article on Azartia's Portuguese licences is paywalled/removed).
'Madeira. Tão tua' branding body (Madeira Promotion Bureau / regional government) not verified from a primary source; recorded as unrated sponsor with ownerId null.

Sleeve/back/shorts sponsors for most clubs beyond the Benfica/Porto/Sporting/Braga cases were left out of kits (only main + front placements recorded); the full Wikipedia table lists them if needed later.

AZ Airlines 'Air Europa' and 'Das WeltAuto' (Alverca shorts/back), 'Hospital CUF' (Maritimo, Santa Clara), 'tvi' operator chain (Media Capital -> Prisa) and all other local-brand ownership chains were not researched.
Gil Vicente's main sponsor is listed as 'Goldenpark Casino' in the Wikipedia table; whether the front-of-shirt brand is the casino or the sportsbook was not separately confirmed.
Estoril Praia's kit maker is listed as Reebok in the Wikipedia table - unusual for a current-season Portuguese club and worth double-checking against a kit launch.
